info.title: TON Prices API — archive and Calcmula
info.description: Read-only API. The collector requests TON/USD every 5 minutes. Reference selects Telegram USD before cutover_at, legacy Calcmula USDT until usd_cutover_at, then Calcmula USD. Original currencies are preserved. Snapshots are not exchange candle closes; the provider market timestamp is unavailable. No synchronous upstream requests are made by this API.

get.summary: Download the complete database as a compressed SQLite snapshot
get.description: All series and original public-channel messages. A separate worker prepares a consistent snapshot every 5 minutes. Gzip file, not a JSON envelope. HEAD returns download metadata; If-None-Match supports 304. Snapshots older than 15 minutes return 503.
